pillow.contract: five centered, untrimmed 128x128 RGBA frames with 2px atlas gutters; idle, telegraph, charged, active, recovery

runtime.trigger: StructureAnimator resolves structureArtKey('MAGMA_TRAP') to the generic idle/telegraph/charged/active/recovery frame vocabulary. MAGMA_TRAP is the entryTrigger family, which already drove every one of those states before this registration (phase 1 = recovery, charge >= 0.65 = charged, charge > 0 = telegraph) and already bumped cycleSeq on eruption (structureBehaviors/entryTrigger.js), so no server or renderer change was needed.

qa.gate: target-branch runtime integration plus manual Phaser footprint and payoff readability confirmation
